title: plasma-apply-wallpaperimage does not respect the 'Switch dynamic wallpapers' setting
line: plasma-apply-wallpaperimage now keeps the "Switch dynamic wallpapers" choice, so "Always use light variant" stays light.
explanation: Whether a dynamic wallpaper shows its light, dark or day-night image is decided by a #light/#dark/#day-night fragment on the Image URL; the DynamicMode entry only remembers the user's choice for the settings page. plasma-apply-wallpaperimage wrote the bare package path, so the fragment was lost and the wallpaper fell back to following the Plasma style. The tool now reads DynamicMode in its script and appends the matching fragment when the package has dark images, like the settings page does.

commits.message:
plasma-apply-wallpaperimage: keep the dynamic wallpaper mode

The tool wrote the bare package path as the Image, dropping the #light,
#dark or #day-night fragment that the "Switch dynamic wallpapers" setting
relies on. For packages with dark images it now appends the fragment.

BUG: 511377

media.caption: Next set to 'Always use light variant' with Breeze Dark; after running plasma-apply-wallpaperimage on Next the dark variant shows (Image lost #light)
Same steps with the fix: the light variant stays and Image keeps #light

review.text: The CLI now appends the #light/#dark/#day-night fragment from the containment's DynamicMode for packages with dark images, as Vlad suggested on the bug, so the cause is fixed where the bug lives. Small and contained; the animated-image #day-night exception is a known minor gap noted in the entry. Before/after show the light variant kept.
